title: Move the active test-run count from the global header chip to a badge on the left-rail test icon
outcome: The global header no longer shows the persistent yellow "Tests: N running · restart impact …" chip. Instead, the left-rail flask/test icon carries a compact badge with the active-run count N, keeps an accessible label/tooltip, and shows no badge when no run is active. Per-run status and restart-impact detail stay in the test view/panel.
acceptance: The global header no longer renders the persistent top-level "Tests: N running · restart impact …" chip.
With N > 0 active test runs, the left-rail flask/test icon shows a compact badge with N, and its accessible name/tooltip states the active-run count.
With zero active test runs, the icon shows no badge or warning styling.
The test view/panel still shows per-run status and restart-impact detail, unchanged.
UI tests cover the badge for N = 0, N = 1 and N > 1, and the absence of the header chip; tsc and the full gate are green.
